title: Implement Alpaca native continuous trailing orders and confirmed broker HWM
description:
Implement the Alpaca trailing_native protection adapter in mike_trade/brokers/alpaca/trailing.py.

Submitting orders:
- Provide build_trailing_stop_request(symbol, qty, policy, client_order_id). It produces a standalone SELL order with type=trailing_stop and exactly one of trail_price or trail_percent, both Decimal and serialized as strings. TIF comes from the policy.
- Always set order_class to simple. A bracket, OTO or OCO order class must never be used with a trailing stop: raise or return a rejection reason if one is requested.
- Validate inputs before building the request: quantity must be positive, the side must be SELL (long-only), and a fractional quantity must be explicitly allowed by the capability set produced via n.1's BrokerProtectionCapabilities.
- Provide submit_trailing_stop(...), replace_trailing_stop(...) and cancel_trailing_stop(...). They take the existing Alpaca HTTP client/port by injection; they must not construct credentials themselves.

Reading broker state:
- Provide parse_trailing_order_state(raw_order) -> NativeTrailingState. It reads the authoritative broker values for: order id, client_order_id, status, hwm, stop_price, trail_price/trail_percent, time_in_force, qty, filled_qty, protected quantity (qty - filled_qty), and the updated_at timestamp. All are parsed to Decimal and timezone-aware UTC.
- Treat missing or unparseable hwm or stop_price on an active order as UNCONFIRMED, not as a value.
- The application must never compute or ratchet the HWM itself. The broker value is the only truth, and NativeTrailingState must be labelled continuous/broker-managed (e.g. behavior='continuous_broker_managed'). It must never be represented as stepped.

Status mapping:
- Map Alpaca statuses to the protection condition vocabulary:
  - new/accepted/pending_new → PENDING
  - accepted with hwm present → ACTIVE
  - replaced/pending_replace → UPDATING
  - filled/partially_filled → TRIGGERED
  - expired/done_for_day → EXPIRED
  - canceled/rejected → UNPROTECTED (unless an intentional coordinated exit is recorded)
- Document that native trailing continues only while the broker order remains active, including while the engine is offline.

Contract tests:
- Write tests/contracts/test_alpaca_native_trailing.py as contract tests against recorded or handcrafted Alpaca JSON payload fixtures embedded in the test.
- Cover: request shape; exactly-one-of trail_price/trail_percent; rejection of a linked trailing leg; HWM/stop_price parsing; status mapping; UNCONFIRMED when hwm is missing; protected-quantity calculation after a partial fill.
- The tests must not hit the network or read credentials.
- Optionally add a test marked skip-unless ALPACA_PAPER credentials are present and an explicit opt-in env var is set. Credential-gated paper verification belongs to the operator, not to this task's verification.

Before editing, inspect:
- mike_trade/brokers/alpaca/ (existing client, order adapter, models and endpoint/paper-live isolation)
- mike_trade/risk/stop_policy.py and mike_trade/risk/protection.py from n.1 (ProtectionPolicy, BrokerProtectionCapabilities, protocol expected by ProtectionCoordinator)
- existing contract test conventions under tests/contracts/
Decision budget: conform to the existing Alpaca client interfaces; do not modify them. If an adapter hook is missing, accept a callable/protocol parameter instead.
acceptance_criteria: build_trailing_stop_request produces a SELL, type=trailing_stop, order_class simple request with exactly one of trail_price or trail_percent. Supplying both or neither raises a validation error (tested).
Requesting a bracket, OTO or OCO order class with a trailing stop is rejected with an explicit reason. No such request is ever produced (tested).
parse_trailing_order_state returns Decimal hwm and stop_price, timezone-aware UTC timestamps, TIF, status and protected quantity equal to qty minus filled_qty (tested with a partial-fill fixture).
An active order with a missing or invalid hwm or stop_price maps to UNCONFIRMED rather than to a fabricated value (tested).
The Alpaca status mapping covers PENDING, ACTIVE, UPDATING, TRIGGERED, EXPIRED and UNPROTECTED as specified (table-driven test).
NativeTrailingState is labelled continuous broker-managed. No code path computes an app-side HWM or labels native trailing as stepped.
A fractional quantity is rejected unless the injected capabilities mark the fractional trailing/TIF combination as supported and paper_proven for LIVE (tested).
tests/contracts/test_alpaca_native_trailing.py passes in isolation with no network access and no credential reads. Any paper test is skipped by default.
forbidden_changes: change PLAN_SKELETON.json or other planning artifacts
attach trailing stops as OTO/bracket/OCO legs
compute or ratchet HWM in application code for native trailing
create live or paper broker orders or read broker credentials during tests
run broad test suites or backtests
